summary: Implemented the rich.progress file-reading feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressFileReader and generic _ProgressFileContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with typed overloads for 'r', 'rt', 'rb'); tests/test_progress.py (25 new tests before the script-entry block); docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased/Added bullet linking PR 1759). Diff is additive only. Unverified: mypy suppressions, black formatting, and Python 3.6 instantiation (BinaryIO base may leave abstract mode/name). Some new docstring lines exceed 88 characters, matching track()'s style.
